newsitem.title: UK: Pearson looks at Australian business daily.
newsitem.headline: Pearson looks at Australian business daily.

text.p: UK media and leisure group Pearson Plc would like to take a stake in business daily The Australian Financial Review, a Pearson spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"We are investigating on a fact-finding basis the possibility of taking a stake. We are not yet at the negotiating stage," she said.
The spokeswoman said that local media ownership laws would prevent Pearson from buying the title outright from publisher John Fairfax Holdings Ltd.
Reports in Sydney newspaper The Australian said that Pearson was part of a consortium considering bidding for all or part of John Fairfax.
Pearson, which publishes Britain's Financial Times, would not want to get involved in general newspaper publishing in Australia, the spokeswoman said.
Australian media mogul Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd is believed to be lining up an A$2.5 billion bid for Fairfax.
However, Packer must wait to see whether Australian Prime Minister John Howard loosens the cross-media ownership laws which, as they stand, bar the deal.
